Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:03:00 +0000
Subject: Kickoff: Pan-EU data mapping & MAP — Nordica Bank

Hi Jürgen / Sofia —

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. As discussed, this thread will be the working space to kick off a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the evaluation plan for Pan‑EU data residency and cross‑border considerations. The primary goals for this kickoff are:

- Confirm scope (systems + data flows) for the MAP and evaluation pilot
- Align stakeholders and owners across Legal, Security, Privacy, and Engineering
- Agree on a short timeline (~6 weeks) to complete data mapping, risk assessment, and pilot evaluation

Proposed immediate asks:
1) Could your team share a current high‑level data flow inventory (CSV or diagram) by end of day Tue, 25 May? If a single export isn’t available, a short list of systems and which EU countries they touch is fine.
2) Please identify the internal owner for contractual/data transfer questions (LegalOps contact) and the technical owner for the inventory.
3) We suggest a 60‑minute technical walkthrough next week to review the inventory and discuss the cross‑border transfer matrix and Schrems II mitigations. Options: Thu 20 May 14:00 CET or Fri 21 May 09:00 CET — which works?

I’ve attached a first‑draft MAP and an inventory template to speed things up (see attachments). For visibility, linking the HubSpot deal and a shared Drive folder below.

High‑level MAP milestones (proposal):
- Week 0 (this week): stakeholder confirmation, inventory handoff
- Week 1: technical walkthrough + data mapping completion
- Weeks 2–3: risk assessment and mitigation proposals (DPA/transfer mechanisms)
- Weeks 4–5: evaluation pilot (hosted vs. private routing) + quant args
- Week 6: decision + contractual next steps / SOC evidence checklist

If that timeline is too aggressive we can stretch to 8 weeks, but a compact window helps lock pricing and capacity planning on our side.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the inventory and the preferred walkthrough slot.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Lead, Enterprise — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference | +1 415‑555‑1783

Neha —

Appreciate the clear plan. Thu 20 May 14:00 CET works best for our side. I've looped in LegalOps and Sofia (data privacy lead). Anders Holm (our external regulatory consultant) will also join the walkthrough — I’ve cc'd him on this thread.

Quick Q: for the evaluation pilot you mention hosted vs. private routing — can you confirm whether the pilot requires any on‑prem components or if it can be done fully in our EU VPC region? That will determine what artifact we need to include in the inventory.

We’ll aim to provide the inventory CSV by Tue 25 May. 

Thanks,
